verdict.rationale: Mirrors captures every production session in the background and compares live sessions that received a correction against held-out sessions using the team's own outcome labels and checks. The UI also shows checks passing on recorded sessions. However, Mirrors positions itself as distinct from evals tools, and success signals are user-supplied rather than evaluators the product runs continuously. Missing for 10: documented continuous or online evaluator execution on live traffic, configurable evaluator types or scoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
